sentences.en: It will take a long time to suppress the revolt.
sentences.zh: 镇压叛乱需要很长时间。

sentences.en: It was very hard for her to suppress her emotions.
sentences.zh: 对她来说克制情绪非常困难。

sentences.en: By using four types of metal, specific frequency resonance is suppressed.
sentences.zh: 通过使用四种金属，特定频率的共振被抑制了。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：sup（下）+press（压）→压下去→镇压
